title: Move compositor conformance ahead of carrier promotion
summary: The second carrier caller exposed a 13.8px realized-paint discontinuity that existing planned-geometry tests missed. Execute the complete v2 conformance contract first, stop at the two/x human checkpoint, and resume carrier promotion only after conformance closeout.
